title: Connect Local Practice Repo to GitHub
description: Create an empty repository on GitHub and link your local `hcc-git-practice` repository to it.
steps: Go to https://github.com/new in your browser (log in if needed)
Set visibility to Public (or Private if you prefer)
IMPORTANT: Leave 'Add a README file', '.gitignore', and 'Choose a license' UNCHECKED (since we already have them locally!)
Click 'Create repository' — copy the HTTPS URL shown on the quick setup page
In your local terminal inside `hcc-git-practice`, run: `git remote add origin <PASTE_YOUR_URL>`
expected_output: `git remote -v` prints two lines showing `origin` with your repository URL for (fetch) and (push).
tips: If you accidentally created the GitHub repo with a README, it will cause a non-fast-forward conflict on your first push. Leaving it empty avoids this completely!
`origin` is simply the standard default alias name for your primary remote repository.
